remainder_derivation: Exact identity 1/(n^2-m^2) = sum_{j<42} m^(2j)/n^(2j+2) + (m/n)^84/(n^2-m^2). Row tail bounded by |c| r0^42 (8*S1 + n*Sz0)/(n^2-M^2) with S1 = sum |dy_m| m, Sz0 = sum (|zhat_m|+err_m) |dy_m|, |z_n| <= 8. l2 sums use n^2-M^2 >= n^2 (1-r0) and integral comparison sum_{step2, n>=N0} n^-4 <= (1+N0/6)/N0^4, n^-2 <= (1+N0/2)/N0^2. Input-z error counted once via the full kernel: |c| n E_z/(n^2-M^2), E_z = sum err_m |dy_m|. Pole error counted once: floor error l1*2^-256 plus L/t midpoint-radius propagation l1 (radL/b + (L+radL) radt/b^3), output side via |dp_n| <= radL/n + (L+radL) radt/n^3.
